articles.author: Snigdha Gairola
articles.headline: Mark Zandi Says June Jobs Report Was Weaker Than It Looked as Labor Force Participation Fell
articles.summary: Zandi says the June jobs report masked labor market weakness, warning that unemployment would top 5% without the decline in labor force participation.
articles._summary: Economist Mark Zandi argued that the June employment report painted an overly optimistic picture of the U.S. labor market, saying several underlying indicators point to a much weaker economy than the headline figures suggest. On Sunday, in a series of posts on X , Zandi said commentary surrounding the June jobs report was "much too dismissive of how weak the numbers looked, all the noise in the data notwithstanding." Zandi noted that payroll employment posted only a modest gain in June, while prior months’ job gains were revised downward. He also said most of the hiring came from the healthcare sector rather than being broadly distributed across the economy. "Not only did employment as measured by the payroll survey post a small gain in the month, but previous month’s gains were revised much lower, and the bulk of the job gains were in healthcare," Zandi wrote.
articles._zh_headline: 马克·赞迪 (Mark Zandi) 表示，六月就业报告比看上去要弱，因为劳动力参与率下降
articles._zh_summary: 经济学家马克·赞迪(Mark Zandi)认为，6月就业报告描绘了美国劳动力市场过于乐观的景象，他表示，一些基本指标表明经济比总体数据要弱得多。周日，赞迪在 X 上的一系列帖子中表示，围绕 6 月份就业报告的评论“尽管数据中存在诸多噪音，但对数据看起来的疲软程度过于轻视”。赞迪指出，六月份就业人数仅小幅增长，​​而前几个月的就业增长则被向下修正。他还表示，大部分招聘来自医疗保健行业，而不是广泛分布在整个经济领域。赞迪写道：“根据薪资调查衡量的就业人数不仅在本月出现小幅增长，​​而且上个月的增长幅度也被修正得更低，而且大部分就业增长来自医疗保健领域。”

articles.summary: OpenAI's Sam Altman praises Apple, despite ongoing legal battle over alleged theft of confidential information.
articles._summary: That praise lands as Apple is in court accusing OpenAI of lifting confidential know-how to speed up its consumer-hardware plans, a dispute outlined in a new lawsuit over alleged hardware secrets . articles.headline: UnitedHealth Watch: Bearish Chart Pattern Raises Stakes for Q2 Earnings
articles.summary: UnitedHealth stock price is on watch this week as key chart patterns point to a retreat after its Q2 earnings later this week.
articles._summary: UnitedHealth Group has seen a strong surge this year, mirroring the performance of other health insurance companies like Elevance Health, Humana and CVS. The rally happened after the Trump administration increased the average Medicare Advantage payments by 2.48% , which is equivalent to $13 billion. That increase was much higher than the proposed payment rate hike of 0.09%.
articles._zh_headline: 联合健康观察：看跌图表模式提高了第二季度收益的风险
articles._zh_summary: 联合健康集团 (UnitedHealth Group) 今年的业绩强劲增长，与 Elevance Health、Humana 和 CVS 等其他健康保险公司的业绩遥相呼应。此次上涨发生在特朗普政府将平均医疗保险优惠付款增加 2.48%（相当于 130 亿美元）之后。这一增幅远高于拟议的 0.09% 的加息幅度。
